$comment: Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz models for the qwentts.cpp helper (tts_helpers::qwen, owned by P6-E). The server loads one talker plus the shared tokenizer: CustomVoice talkers for the 9 preset voices (tts/qwen3-tts-1.7b and tts/qwen3-tts-0.6b, the size ids of resources::policy::ids), Base talkers for cloning library voices (-base), and the 1.7B VoiceDesign talker for voices described in words (there is no 0.6B VoiceDesign). Every talker requires tts/qwen3-tts-tokenizer.

Q8_0 GGUFs converted by the qwentts.cpp author (Serveurperso/Qwen3-TTS-GGUF), the quantization upstream validates (per-stage cosine against PyTorch >= 0.9994; RVQ codebooks and the speaker encoder stay F32 in every quant), pinned to a repo commit with the LFS sha256 (scripts/models/pin-catalog.mjs).

min_vram_mb equals the resource governor's per-size estimate (resources::policy: 3200 / 1500 MiB; a test keeps them equal). qwentts.cpp also allocates a 4096-token f32 KV cache (896 MB on both sizes) plus about 0.4 GB of CUDA context, so the 0.6B footprint is likely nearer 2.3 GB: the helper claims this number while it loads and resizes the claim to the buffers the server logs. Replace both with the P7 measurements together.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 12 Hz tokenizer
entries.description: The audio codec every Qwen3-TTS voice model uses: turns the model's output into 24 kHz speech and reads reference clips for voice cloning. About 290 MB.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B voices
entries.description: Alibaba's expressive speech model with 9 built-in voices that follow style and emotion instructions, in Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian. Runs on the graphics card. About 2 GB download; uses about 3.2 GB of video memory.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B voice cloning
entries.description: Speaks in a voice from your voice library after hearing a clean 3 to 10 second clip of it (best with the clip's transcript). Runs on the graphics card. About 2.1 GB download; uses about 3.2 GB of video memory.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B voice design
entries.description: Creates a voice from a description in words (age, gender, pitch, mood, style). Runs on the graphics card. About 2 GB download; uses about 3.2 GB of video memory.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B voices
entries.description: The smaller model with the same 9 built-in voices (no style instructions), for graphics cards that also run the voice changer. About 970 MB download.

entries.title: Qwen3-TTS 0.6B voice cloning
entries.description: The smaller voice-cloning model, for graphics cards that also run the voice changer. About 990 MB download.
